body:
**RAV-RUN3-R1-F003 [low] CLI help** — `--input-json` help omits an explicit network exception

`--input-json` says it is offline, but `--registry-live` remains an explicit network exception. The corrected help text names that exception.

**RAV-RUN3-R1-F004 [low] registry reporting** — The CLI reports zero registry counts before live lookups produce the actual totals

The CLI prints registry status before live lookups. The initial zero-count line therefore does not show the actual query and error totals.

The corrected path replaces it with one final status line before publication checks that shows the actual query and error totals.

**RAV-RUN3-R1-F005 [low] CLI** — Negative `--limit` values use Python negative slicing

`--limit 0` processes all models. Negative limits use Python negative slicing.

The corrected path rejects negative limits, and slicing runs whenever the value is not `None`, including `0`.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F002 [low] CLI help** — The top-level `every_eval_ever validate` help says supported directory arguments are unsupported

The top-level `every_eval_ever validate` help still says directory arguments are unsupported. The corrected help text describes recursive directory expansion.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F003 [low] documentation** — The validation path leaves parent depth unchecked

Still present. Parent depth is unchecked only when the collection leaf also passes validation.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F003 [low] deployment metadata** — Supported logs normally publish `deployment_type` and `model_availability` as `unknown`

There is no CLI override for known facts. In the corrected path, validated CLI overrides follow the existing platform and engine override pattern.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F010 [low] test coverage** — The test suite does not prove strict output parsing through the real CLI

The thorough synthetic fixture is useful. An end-to-end publication assertion would also prove strict output parsing through the real CLI.

The fix uses the existing fixture to drive one CLI publication test that strictly parses and validates each emitted file.
